theme: Dian Dou De, New Year's Eve

items.title: Get up, get ready
items.note: Dian Dou De serves as brunch; no separate breakfast needed.

items.title: K Hotel → Dian Dou De (点都德)
items.note: Search “点都德” in Amap, pick the nearest Tianhe branch, and walk over to take a queue number.
items.tip: Calling ahead to ask about reservations can save queuing.

items.title: Dim sum brunch: Dian Dou De
items.note: Orders are placed by scanning the QR code at the table; dim sum is made to order.

food.name: Golden crispy shrimp red rice roll (金莎红米肠)
food.desc: The most famous signature: pink rice sheet wrapped around crispy shrimp. Must try.

food.name: Honey char siu bao, signature siu mai (蜜汁叉烧包、招牌烧卖)
Satay beef tripe, steamed chicken feet with lily-bulb sauce (沙爹金钱肚、百合酱蒸凤爪)
food.desc: For those who like bolder flavours.

food.name: Mango coconut milk layer cake, caramel iced tofu pudding (香芒夹心椰汁糕、焦糖冰豆花)

items.title: Tianhe Road shopping walk
items.note: For those who did not do this route on the 29th.

route.title: Teemall (天河城)
route.desc: Long-established mall, with New Year decorations at year end.

route.title: Parc Central (天环广场)
route.walk: Direct via the underground passage from Teemall

route.title: Taikoo Hui (太古汇)
route.walk: Exit Parc Central and walk east along Tianhe Road, ~10 min
route.desc: High-end brands and strongly design-led shops.

food.name: French patisserie at Taikoo Hui (太古汇法式甜品店)

route.title: Wong Chun Loong Herbal Tea (黄振龙凉茶)
route.walk: Search “黄振龙” in Amap and pick the branch near Tianhe Road
route.desc: Herbal jelly (龟苓膏), 24-herb tea (廿四味). Kids can have the milder Xia Sang Ju (夏桑菊).

route.title: Fashion Tianhe (时尚天河)
route.walk: ~10 min walk to under Tianhe Sports Center

items.title: Free time
items.note: Rest at the hotel or wander nearby.

items.title: New Year's Eve dinner: eat early
items.note: Restaurants are packed on New Year's Eve; arrive by 17:00, ideally with a booking.

food.name: Restaurants at Taikoo Hui (太古汇)
food.desc: Pleasant setting; suited to a proper New Year's Eve meal.

food.name: Grandview Mall food floor (正佳美食层)

items.title: Tianhe Road at night
items.note: New Year lights along Teemall and Grandview. Leave early if it gets crowded.
items.tip: Metro stations may be temporarily controlled on New Year's Eve; walking back to the hotel is preferable.

items.title: Walk back to the hotel
items.note: The countdown is skipped, avoiding the crowds around Huacheng Square and Canton Tower.

intro:
Dim sum brunch at Dian Dou De
Afternoon: Option A Tianhe Road mall walk / Option B free time
Early New Year's Eve dinner; Tianhe Road lights
